page_description: I am currently revamping my personal webpage to make it more informative and visually appealing.
reach_me_intro: In the meantime, you can reach me on
footer_copyright: © {year} Faisal Hanif. Build {build}. Created with SvelteKit {version}
meta_default_description: Faisal Hanif is a software engineer. Selected Git projects, writing, and a direct way to get in touch.
meta_blog_description: Writing by Faisal Hanif, set for a comfortable reading measure.
meta_studio_description: Drafts, published writing, and Git project showcases.
hero_lede: I design and build software people can actually use. Clear interfaces, careful motion, and the systems behind them. This is the public record of that work.
about_title: Built to be used, and to feel finished.
about_body: I'm Faisal Hanif. I work as a software engineer across the interface and the system underneath it: product code, the motion that makes state legible, and notes when the work is worth writing down.
about_point_1_body: Web applications from the data model through the screen a person actually touches.
about_point_2_body: Animation that explains a change of state. If it does not help someone understand the interface, it does not ship.
about_point_3_body: Notes on the work, published when they are ready to be read.
work_site_body: Portfolio, blog, and studio. Drafts, publishing, and a rich-text editor, with the interface in two languages.
contact_body: Email is the fastest way to reach me professionally. I also read messages on LinkedIn.
blog_lede: Notes and longer pieces, set for a comfortable line length. The same posts appear in either language of the interface.
blog_empty_body: Published writing will show up here. Drafts stay in the studio until they are ready.
login_lede: This entrance is for editing the site. There is no public registration.
studio_lede: Drafts, published notes, and the projects on the homepage.
analytics_lede: How people find the site, how long they stay with a post, and what they open.
analytics_impressions_hint: Times a published post was opened.
analytics_unique_hint: Distinct hashed browser fingerprints. This is not a name or an account.
analytics_read_hint: Average is total reading time divided by visitors who actually stayed to read.
analytics_interest_hint: Clicks from the homepage toward GitHub, LinkedIn, or email.
analytics_empty: No visits in this period yet.
empty_studio_body: Try another filter, or start a new draft.
field_excerpt_hint: Shown on cards. Leave it blank to use the opening of the post.
editor_hint: Shortcuts like # for headings and ** for bold work while you type. Drop an image or video into the text to upload it.
delete_body: This removes the draft or the published page. It cannot be undone.
toast_link_invalid: Enter a valid http, https, mailto, or site link.
toast_upload_failed: The upload did not finish. Try again.
toast_upload_type: Use a JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP, AVIF, MP4, WebM, or MOV file.
toast_upload_large: That file is too large. Images can be 12 MB, videos 80 MB.
error_body: The link may be old, or the post is still a draft.
motion_idle_body: At rest. The rings keep a slow rhythm, and nothing asks for attention.
motion_focus_body: Attention. The mark grows and the rhythm tightens, so the change is obvious.
motion_confirm_body: Resolved. The mark settles into a check. The motion stops once the state is clear.
project_empty_body: Selected repositories will be listed here.
studio_projects_lede: Git repositories shown on the homepage. A GitHub link fills language, topics, and stars when those fields are empty.
project_field_repo_hint: Use an https link. GitHub links can fill in the empty fields when you save.
project_field_order_hint: Lower numbers appear first on the homepage.
project_delete_body: This removes it from the studio and from the homepage. It does not delete the repository.
validation_repo: Enter an https Git repository URL.
validation_site: Enter a valid https link, or leave the live site blank.
